$comment: Native level -> SARIF level for the tools Spectra converts (SPCTR-304). Spectra maps SARIF levels to severities: error=HIGH, warning=MEDIUM, note=LOW. Every native scale is ordered (style <= info <= warning <= error); lint rules are code smells, so only a tool's own 'error' reaches HIGH. 'unparsed' lists rule ids that mean the file could not be analysed: they are reported as unparsed files, never as findings. hadolint and biome emit SARIF natively and keep their own levels.
